title: CBRD-26659 replay bundle index (one per attempt)
description: The index of one attempt's bulky evidence under the campaign's /home storage. Every item the specification lists is present in the index with a state: present, missing, or not-applicable. Missing evidence is recorded as missing; a bundle with missing items is never described as complete. Bundles are referenced from attempt records and matrix rows by path and hash.

root_path.description: Bundle directory under /home; the temporary filesystem is unsuitable.

complete.description: True only when no item is in state missing.

seed_and_generator_version.description: Seed value, generator name and version; not-applicable for fixed deterministic workloads.

session_and_barrier_trace.description: Ordered operations and acknowledged phase schedule; not-applicable for single-session cases.

injection_acknowledgements.description: Site, target operation, occurrence count, requested action and fired acknowledgement per fault; not-applicable without instrumentation.

engine_identity.description: Baseline commit, version string, library hashes.

specification_identity.description: Context revision, content hash, catalogue hash.

build_and_configuration_identity.description: Build mode, configure options, page size, run mode, cubrid.conf and broker configuration as used.

instrumentation_identity.description: Patch id and hash, build hash, fault-disabled control reference; not-applicable for unmodified runs.

fixture_identity.description: Database names, createdb parameters, fixture generation inputs.

expected_versus_actual.description: Expected output, actual output and the comparison.

logs.description: Server, client, CTP and utility logs; debug oos.log where produced.

cores.description: Core files with matching binaries noted; not-applicable when no process crashed.

replay_command_with_prerequisites.description: The command that replays the attempt and the prerequisites (install, databases, services) it assumes.

uncommitted_snapshots.description: Source or specification snapshots kept when a commit alone does not identify the input.

class.description: success-bulky: seven days. failure: through triage plus thirty days. minimized-reproducer: kept.

hold_reason.description: Set when an unresolved finding still needs the bundle past its expiry.

minimization.description: Set on minimized derivatives; both the failure and the relevant OOS path must remain.

reduction.description: What was reduced: rows, operations, values, participants.

note.description: Why an item is missing or not applicable.
